data.title: 由比滨结衣 · 侍奉部活动室·夕阳余晖与微风红茶
data.description: 【由比滨结衣 · 侍奉部活动室·夕阳余晖与微风红茶】夕阳将侍奉部教室的一切染上蜜糖般的暖橙色，微风拂动窗帘与结衣蓬松的粉色团子发髻。她双手捧着小雪泡好的热红茶，向你露出毫无阴霾的灿烂笑容——「小企！今天的红茶超级香哦！大家能像这样每天聚在一起聊天，真的最喜欢了！」
data.promptProse: Yui sits beside the Service Club window and offers freshly brewed red tea with a bright smile, coral hair gathered into its familiar bun. Her open school blazer, pink cardigan, red ribbon and pleated skirt retain the selected uniform. The medium portrait includes the cup above the desk and classroom chairs receding behind. Golden-hour window light illuminates her face and tea surface, casting the cup's rounded shadow across the nearby tabletop.

data.action: 坐在窗边端着红茶，夕阳洒在脸上
